title: Request professional service
steps: LG publishes no user troubleshooting for the humidity sensor fault; request repair service.

meaning: The ice-maker fan is faulty.
title: Defrost and check the door
steps: Perform a manual defrost, inspect the door gasket for tears, and verify door alignment and leveling; request service if persistent.

meaning: The refrigerator compartment fan motor is faulty.
title: Manually defrost
steps: Perform a full manual defrost (doors open eight or more hours), confirm vents are clear and doors close properly, then request service if the fan error returns.

meaning: The refrigerator temperature sensor is open or shorted.
title: Request professional service
steps: LG publishes no user troubleshooting for the refrigerator sensor fault; request repair service.

meaning: The ambient room-temperature sensor is open or shorted.
title: Request professional service
steps: LG publishes no user troubleshooting for the room-temperature sensor fault; request repair service.

meaning: An over-current condition was detected in the motor drive circuit.
title: Power-cycle the washer
steps: Unplug for ten seconds, restore power, and attempt a cycle.

meaning: The door could not be confirmed locked before the cycle started.
title: Reset the door lock
steps: Unplug the washer, hold Start/Pause for five seconds while unpowered, restore power, close the door firmly, and restart.

meaning: The door could not be confirmed locked before the cycle started.
title: Replace the door lock assembly
steps: If the door still will not lock after the reset, disconnect power and replace the door lock and switch assembly.

meaning: The door-latch switch is not reading the door as closed.
title: Clear the door and reset
steps: Remove anything caught in the door, unplug for ten seconds, restore power, and retry the cycle.

meaning: A foreign object or jam was detected between the drum and the pulsator.
title: Remove the obstruction
steps: Empty the tub and check between the drum and pulsator for coins or foreign objects, removing any with pliers.

meaning: Water rose past the safe threshold, indicating an overfill.
title: Drain the overfill
steps: Close both water taps, power on, select the no-spin option, press Start/Pause to drain, then restart.

meaning: Water did not reach the required level within the fill window, indicating an inadequate supply.
title: Restore adequate water flow
steps: Open the water tap fully, straighten any kink in the fill hose, and clean the inlet screen filter if it is clogged; confirm household water pressure is adequate.

meaning: Water did not reach the required level within the fill window, indicating an inadequate supply.
title: Replace the water inlet valve
steps: If supply, hoses, and filter check out and the fill error returns, disconnect power and water and replace the cold water inlet valve.

meaning: Motor overload protection tripped after the drive motor stalled or locked.
title: Let the motor cool
steps: Leave the washer off for about thirty minutes so the drive motor can cool, then restart the cycle.

meaning: Water was not expelled from the tub within the expected drain window.
title: Clear the drain path
steps: Straighten the drain hose and clear any blockage, then remove and clean the drain filter.

meaning: Water was not expelled from the tub within the expected drain window.
title: Replace the drain pump
steps: If the hose and filter are clear and the code returns, disconnect power and water, open the access panel, and replace the drain pump and motor assembly.

meaning: The water-level pressure sensor reported a reading outside its valid range.
title: Power-cycle the washer
steps: Unplug the washer for ten seconds, restore power, and restart the cycle.

meaning: Power to the washer was interrupted during a running cycle.
title: Reset after power loss
steps: Unplug or trip the breaker, hold Start/Pause for five seconds while unpowered, restore power, and run a cycle.

meaning: Excess foam was detected and the wash paused to disperse it.
title: Reduce detergent
steps: Use no more than the recommended amount of detergent and reduce it until the sudsing stops.

meaning: Maintenance reminder that the tub-clean cycle is due.
title: Run the tub-clean cycle
steps: Empty the tub, add washing-machine cleaner powder, select the Tub Clean cycle, and start it.

meaning: The water-heating circuit or its thermistor is out of range.
title: Power-cycle and drain
steps: Unplug for ten seconds, restore power, select a no-spin drain, then restart the cycle.

meaning: The drum could not balance the load well enough to spin safely.
title: Rebalance the load
steps: Redistribute the laundry evenly around the drum, adding a few similar items for very small loads, then restart the cycle.

meaning: No detergent cartridge is detected in the dispenser.
title: Reseat the detergent cartridge
steps: Insert the dispenser cartridge correctly and close the drawer fully.

meaning: The washer is not draining properly.
title: Review the installation
steps: Slow draining is often an installation issue; verify the drain setup and schedule service if it persists.

meaning: The door is not locking properly.
title: Clear the door and reset
steps: Remove anything blocking the door so it closes fully, then press Pause/Cancel twice and Power once to clear.

meaning: The door is not locking properly.
title: Replace the door latch
steps: If nothing blocks the door and the lock error returns after clearing, disconnect power and replace the door latch assembly.

meaning: A motor speed-sensing error was detected.
title: Check bolts and load
steps: Confirm all shipping bolts were removed and the drum is not overloaded, then clear the code with Pause/Cancel twice and Power once.

meaning: The washer senses a low flow of water during fill.
title: Open the water supply
steps: Turn the household supply on, open both faucets fully, straighten kinked inlet hoses, and remove any anti-flood devices.

meaning: A problem was detected with the dispenser system.
title: Clean the dispenser
steps: Check the detergent drawer or cartridge for clogged detergent and clean it out.

meaning: Draining is taking longer than expected (over about eight minutes).
title: Clear the drain path
steps: Straighten or unclog the drain hose, fit the U-shaped form, verify standpipe height, and use HE detergent.

meaning: The hot and cold inlet hoses are connected in reverse.
title: Swap the hoses
steps: Turn off the water supply, reverse the hot and cold inlet hoses, and run a cycle to confirm.

meaning: The cycle was paused or cancelled.
title: Clear the interrupted cycle
steps: Press Pause/Cancel twice and Power once; if the code stays, disconnect power for five minutes.

meaning: The lid is not locking.
title: Clear the lid lock
steps: Remove items from under the lid and clean detergent buildup around the lid-lock mechanism.

meaning: The lid cannot unlock.
title: Clear the washer top
steps: Remove objects such as a laundry basket from the top of the washer so the lid can unlock.

meaning: The lid was left open.
title: Close the lid
steps: Close the lid to clear the display; if the tub drained, restart the cycle without adding more detergent.

meaning: The control lock is active, disabling the panel.
title: Release the control lock
steps: Press the Control Lock button; on older models the owner's manual identifies which button toggles the lock.

meaning: The load is out of balance.
title: Rebalance the load
steps: Redistribute items loosely and evenly around the washplate, close the lid, and press Start/Pause.

meaning: The load is too large.
title: Lighten the load
steps: Remove several items, add HE detergent, close the lid, and press Start/Pause.

meaning: The wash cycle was interrupted by a power failure.
title: Restart after the outage
steps: Touch and hold Start to resume the cycle, or press Power to clear the display.

meaning: Items were detected in the drum during the Clean Washer cycle.
title: Empty the drum
steps: Remove all items from the drum and restart the Clean Washer cycle.

meaning: Too many suds were detected in the wash.
title: Cut the suds
steps: Switch to HE detergent, avoid no-splash chlorine bleach, and confirm the drain hose is not kinked or clogged.

meaning: A short circuit was detected in the NTC temperature sensor.
A water intake fault was detected.
title: Restore the water intake
steps: Open the tap fully, confirm flow of at least five litres in fifteen seconds, straighten the inlet hose, and rinse the plastic inlet filter clean.

meaning: A water intake fault was detected.
title: Replace the inlet valve
steps: If supply and filter check out, have the inlet valve solenoids tested and the valve assembly replaced if defective.

meaning: A communication link failure was detected.
Low voltage is reaching the drive.
The machine is having difficulty draining.
title: Clean the drain filter
steps: Unplug the machine, open the lower access panel with a tray ready for water, unscrew the drain filter, clear lint and debris, and refit it securely.

meaning: The machine is having difficulty draining.
title: Clear the drain hose
steps: Remove kinks and loops from the drain hose, keep its end no higher than about one metre from the floor, and flush the hose through if blocked.

meaning: The machine is having difficulty draining.
title: Service the drain pump
steps: If drainage still fails, have the pump impeller checked for debris or damage, the pump tested electrically, and the assembly replaced if defective.

meaning: A fault was detected in the hot water intake.
Excess detergent (over-foaming) was detected.
The flow meter is turning too slowly.
An open circuit or fault was detected in the NTC temperature sensor.
A heating malfunction was detected.
title: Reset and retry
steps: Disconnect from the mains for at least two minutes, reconnect, and rerun the programme.

meaning: A heating malfunction was detected.
title: Service the heating circuit
steps: If heating still fails, have the element, NTC sensors, and Thermostop control checked and any faulty component replaced.

meaning: The steam heater is inactive.
The door is failing to lock.
title: Clear the door and reset
steps: Power off for two minutes, remove anything blocking the latch, close the door fully, and retry with a lighter load.

meaning: The door is failing to lock.
title: Service the door lock
steps: If the door still fails to lock, have the lock switch, latch, and wiring harness inspected and the door lock assembly replaced if damaged.

meaning: The door is failing to unlock.
A failure was detected in the electronic unit.
Faulty electronic memory is returning incorrect data.
The appliance model is not programmed in the control.
The flash RAM is defective.
A drive fault was detected.
A level-switch or pressure-sensor fault was detected.
A speed sensor (tachometer) fault was detected.
title: Reset the electronics
steps: Unplug for five to ten minutes to reset the controls, then run a short empty cycle.

meaning: A speed sensor (tachometer) fault was detected.
title: Service the tachogenerator and brushes
steps: If the speed fault returns, have the tachogenerator readings checked against service specs, worn carbon brushes replaced in pairs, and the motor-to-board wiring verified.

meaning: The final spin speed stayed below 400 rpm.
The program selector is defective.
A failure was detected in the water path control unit.
The drum lighting cap is missing.
Steam is inactive in the heater unit.
Excessive temperature was detected in the heater unit.
A hygiene warning: risk of bacterial contamination from low-temperature washing.
A clogged filter (Waterwall models) or heater over-temperature (Rotary models), depending on model.
A drain-pump operation fault was detected.
title: Reset then service
steps: Turn the dishwasher off and start the cycle again; if the pump fault persists, contact support for service.

meaning: Incoming water is hotter than the allowed limit.
The water supply is inadequate in pressure or temperature.
title: Restore the water supply
steps: Confirm the supply valve is open and the inlet hose is unkinked with adequate pressure and temperature.

meaning: The dishwasher cannot drain.
title: Clear the drain
steps: Clear the filter and drain hose of any blockage, then restart the cycle.

meaning: The dishwasher cannot drain.
title: Replace the drain pump
steps: If the filter and hose are clear and the drain error returns, disconnect power and water and replace the drain pump assembly.

meaning: The Waterwall reflector is not moving correctly.
The water level inside the tub is too low.
title: Rerun and reset
steps: Empty the unit, add detergent, and run a normal cycle; if it continues, power off at the breaker and request service.

meaning: A panel button is being sensed as stuck.
title: Free the stuck button
steps: Turn the dishwasher off and press each panel button once; if a button stays stuck or the error returns, contact support.

meaning: A communication fault occurred in the control electronics.
The water overheated beyond the safe limit.
title: Reset at the breaker
steps: Switch power off for thirty seconds at the breaker and back on, empty the unit, add detergent, and run a Normal cycle.

meaning: The heater temperature-detection circuit is faulty.
title: Rerun and reset
steps: Empty the unit, add detergent and run a normal cycle; if it persists, power off at the breaker and contact support.

meaning: The leak sensor detected moisture.
title: Investigate the leak
steps: The unit will keep draining until dry; check for a blocked Waterwall reflector on those models and inspect for leaks before restarting.

meaning: The water level is above the allowed maximum.
The temperature sensor is reading incorrectly.
A drive-motor fault was detected.
title: Reset then service
steps: Power off for two to three minutes and restart; if the motor error returns, request service.

meaning: The voltage supplied to the dryer is abnormal.
title: Fix the power supply
steps: Run the dryer on its own circuit without an extension cord and confirm correct cord installation and voltage; contact support if it persists.

meaning: Internal control modules cannot communicate with each other.
title: Power-cycle the dryer
steps: Shut the dryer off for sixty seconds and turn it back on; contact support if the communication error remains.

meaning: A control-panel button is being sensed as stuck.
title: Free the stuck button
steps: Power off and individually touch and release every button on the panel, working across each button's edges.

meaning: The exhaust vent is roughly eighty percent blocked.
title: Clean filter and vent
steps: Clean the lint filter and the exhaust vent, then rerun the cycle.

meaning: The exhaust vent is more than ninety percent blocked.
title: Clean filter and vent
steps: Clean the lint filter and the exhaust vent thoroughly — the vent is more than ninety percent blocked — then rerun the cycle.

meaning: The exhaust vent is clogged.
title: Clean filter and vent
steps: Clean the lint filter and the exhaust vent, then rerun the cycle.

meaning: The ambient temperature is outside the operating range.
title: Let the dryer acclimate
steps: Wait about an hour with the dryer at room temperature before restarting.

meaning: A fault was detected with the door, latch, or door sensor.
title: Secure the door
steps: Check the latch is intact, remove anything caught in the door, and close it until it latches fully.

meaning: The power-source frequency is invalid.
title: Restart the cycle
steps: Restart the cycle; if the frequency error remains, contact support.

meaning: The dryer is overheating.
title: Clean lint and check voltage
steps: Clean the lint screen and vent system; on electric models have an electrician confirm the supply voltage if overheating persists.

meaning: The dryer is overheating.
title: Replace the heating element
steps: If airflow is clear and overheating returns, disconnect power and replace the heating element.

meaning: A gas-ignition fault was detected on gas models.
title: Reset then service
steps: Power off for two to three minutes and restart; if the gas-ignition error returns, request service.

meaning: The load did not dry within the expected time.
title: Reset and retry
steps: Power off for two to three minutes and restart the cycle; consult the manual and request service if it returns.

meaning: The temperature-sensing circuit reported a fault.
title: Clean the lint screen and vent
steps: Clean the lint screen, the vent system, or both — trapped heat is the most common cause; contact support if the error continues.

meaning: The freezer fan is not rotating as sensed by the control.
title: Defrost or request service
steps: Ensure the freezer is not overpacked and the door gaskets seal fully; defrost the unit if you wish, otherwise request service.

meaning: The fridge fan is faulty, sometimes following a door left open.
title: Defrost the fridge fan
steps: Unplug the refrigerator and leave the doors open for a few hours, then plug it back in; request service if the error returns.

meaning: The ice-pipe heater reported a fault.
title: Request professional service
steps: Samsung directs this ice-pipe heater fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: The ice-maker function reported a fault.
title: Request professional service
steps: Samsung directs this ice-maker function fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: The ice-room fan reported a fault.
title: Request professional service
steps: Samsung directs this ice-room fan fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: The fridge defrost sensor reported a fault.
title: Request professional service
steps: Samsung directs this defrost-sensor fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: Water was detected in the autofill compartment.
title: Inspect the autofill pitcher
steps: Follow the autofill leak guidance: remove and inspect the autofill compartment for water and dry it out.

meaning: The compressor drew abnormal current.
title: Power-cycle at the breaker
steps: Unplug or switch off the breaker for sixty seconds, then restore power; request service if the code returns.

meaning: The compressor is locked.
title: Request professional service
steps: Samsung directs the compressor-lock fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: Low voltage was detected at the power source.
title: Clear the voltage notice
steps: Press OK for three seconds to clear; the code is harmless and typically follows a brief outage.

meaning: The compressor experienced an undervoltage (brown-out) condition.
title: Power-cycle at the breaker
steps: Unplug or switch off the breaker for sixty seconds, then restore power; request service if the code returns.

meaning: The compressor experienced an overvoltage (surge) condition.
title: Power-cycle at the breaker
steps: Unplug or switch off the breaker for sixty seconds, then restore power; request service if the code returns.

meaning: The freezer ice-maker sensor reported a fault.
title: Request professional service
steps: Samsung directs this ice-maker sensor fault to service; contact the Support Center.

meaning: A communication fault occurred between internal components.
title: Reseat the door harness
steps: Unplug the unit, disconnect and reconnect the wire harness above the door, then restore power; request service if the error returns.

meaning: A low water level was detected during operation.
title: Check hose and leaks
steps: Verify the drain hose position and inspect for leaks.

meaning: A control-panel button fault was detected.
title: Clean the buttons
steps: Clean the control buttons with a dampened cloth.

meaning: A signal communication fault was detected.
title: Power-cycle and wait
steps: Wait briefly or power-cycle, then restart the programme.

meaning: The water-level sensor reported a fault.
title: Power-cycle the washer
steps: Switch off for one minute, then restart the programme.

meaning: The water-level sensor or leak detection reported a fault.
title: Check for leaks and suds
steps: Inspect hoses for kinks and leaks and run an empty cycle to confirm no excess suds are present.

meaning: A drive-motor fault was detected.
title: Power-cycle the washer
steps: Switch off for one minute, then restart the programme; request service if the motor fault returns.

meaning: A drive-motor fault was detected.
title: Reset then service
steps: Power off for two to three minutes and restart; if the motor fault returns, request service.

meaning: An electronic control fault was detected.
title: Restart the cycle
steps: Restart the cycle; request service if the control fault returns.

meaning: The washer is not receiving water correctly during fill.
title: Restore the water supply
steps: Open the tap fully, confirm supply pressure is within 0.5 to 8 bar, clean the mesh filter, and check the hose for kinks.

meaning: The washer is not receiving water correctly during fill.
title: Restore the water supply
steps: Confirm the hoses are connected without kinks, open the supply valves fully, seat the drain hose correctly, and power-cycle for one minute.

meaning: The cold supply line is running unexpectedly hot, indicating reversed hoses.
The incoming water is running hot, indicating a hot-tap connection.
title: Connect to the cold supply
steps: Ensure the inlet hose is connected to the cold (blue) tap, not the hot supply.

meaning: The washer cannot drain the water away.
title: Clear the drain
steps: Empty via the emergency drain hose, clean the pump filter, and check the drain hose for blockages or kinks.

meaning: Water is not leaving the tub at the expected rate, or at all.
title: Clear the drain path
steps: Check the drain hose and drain filter for clogs or kinks, clear them, then restart the cycle.

meaning: Water is not leaving the tub at the expected rate, or at all.
title: Replace the drain pump
steps: If the drain path is clear and the code returns, disconnect power and water, open the lower access panel, and replace the drain pump (the component Samsung attributes to this code).

meaning: The water heater is malfunctioning.
title: Request professional service
steps: Samsung directs water-heater faults to the Service Centre.

meaning: The vibration (MEMS) sensor reported a fault.
The vibration (MEMS) sensor reported a fault.
title: Power-cycle the washer
steps: Power off and restart the cycle.

meaning: An irregularity was detected in the supply voltage.
Low supply voltage was detected.
title: Check the power supply
steps: Verify the power supply and plug connection deliver stable voltage.

meaning: A communication fault occurred between electronic modules.
The washer is running a calibration cycle.
title: Let calibration finish
steps: Verify the cold water supply and allow the calibration cycle to complete.

meaning: The door is not fully closed or something is trapped in it.
title: Secure the door
steps: Ensure the door is fully closed with nothing trapped in it.

meaning: The door is not closed and locked.
title: Secure the door
steps: Confirm the latch is intact, clear anything caught in the door, and close it firmly until it locks.

meaning: The door is not closed and locked.
title: Replace the door lock
steps: If the latch is intact and the door still reads open, disconnect power and replace the door lock switch assembly.

meaning: The AddWash door was opened without pausing the cycle.
title: Close and resume
steps: Close the AddWash door and press Start/Pause to resume.

meaning: The on/off switch reported a fault.
title: Rest and retry
steps: Power off, wait five minutes, and try again.

meaning: An overflow condition was detected, often from excess detergent.
title: Reduce detergent and reset
steps: Use less detergent, then power-cycle and restart.

meaning: An unbalanced load was detected.
title: Rebalance the load
steps: Redistribute the laundry, or add items to balance a small load.

meaning: A motor fault was detected.
title: Power-cycle the washer
steps: Switch off for one minute, then restart the programme.

meaning: The temperature sensor is reading incorrectly.
title: Power-cycle the washer
steps: Switch off for one minute, then restart the programme.

meaning: A fan fault was detected on washer-dryer models.
title: Request professional service
steps: Samsung directs fan faults to the Service Centre.

meaning: The heating circuit is out of range.
title: Basic reset
steps: Power off for two to three minutes, power on, and restart the cycle; contact support if it persists.

meaning: The dryer heater overheated and shut down for safety.
title: Request professional service
steps: The dryer heater shut down for safety; contact the Service Centre.

meaning: The steam function is malfunctioning.
title: Request professional service
steps: Samsung directs steam-function faults to the Service Centre.

meaning: The appliance is hot and the fan is running until it cools.
title: Let it cool
steps: Not a fault: the fan runs until the appliance cools to about 55 degrees Celsius.

meaning: The water level rose above the permitted maximum.
title: Address the overflow
steps: Follow the drainage checks to remove excess water and inspect for a stuck water valve or level sensor.

meaning: A clutch-position fault was detected.
A power fault was detected at the socket or fuse.
title: Check socket and fuse
steps: Power-cycle, check the socket, and replace the plug fuse if needed.

meaning: The detergent drawer is not fully closed.
Excess suds were detected and the cycle paused to clear the foam.
title: Clear the suds
steps: Run an empty cycle with no additives until the suds clear, then reduce detergent going forward.

meaning: A temperature-sensor fault was detected.
The load is unbalanced and the drum cannot spin safely.
title: Rebalance the load
steps: Untangle and redistribute the laundry evenly in the tub, close the door, and restart.

meaning: Voltage fluctuation was detected in the supply.
title: Stabilize the supply
steps: Connect directly to a wall socket without extension cables and verify the supply.

meaning: Airflow through the venting system is restricted.
title: Clear the vent
steps: Check the lint screen and vent for blockages, and straighten any crushed or kinked duct sections.

meaning: The primary control board failed.
title: Request professional service
steps: Whirlpool directs F-series control faults to service; the primary control board has failed.

meaning: The keypad or user interface failed.
title: Request professional service
steps: Whirlpool directs F-series control faults to service; the keypad or user interface has failed.

meaning: A door lock fault was detected.
title: Request professional service
steps: Whirlpool directs F-series faults to service; have the door lock diagnosed.

meaning: A heating element fault was detected.
title: Request professional service
steps: Whirlpool directs F-series faults to service; have the heating element diagnosed.

meaning: A communication fault was detected.
title: Request professional service
steps: Whirlpool directs F-series faults to service; have the control communication diagnosed.

meaning: A communication fault was detected.
title: Request professional service
steps: Whirlpool directs F-series faults to service; have the control communication diagnosed.

meaning: A motor drive fault was detected.
title: Request professional service
steps: Whirlpool directs F-series faults to service; have the motor drive diagnosed.

meaning: A moisture sensor fault was detected.
title: Request professional service
steps: Whirlpool directs F-series faults to service; have the moisture sensor diagnosed.

meaning: Airflow is restricted in the venting system.
title: Clear the vent
steps: Check the lint screen and vent for blockages, and straighten any crushed or kinked duct sections.

meaning: Low or no line voltage was detected.
title: Check the power supply
steps: Verify the home power supply and breaker deliver correct voltage to the dryer; low line voltage keeps the heater from turning on.

meaning: A power failure interrupted the drying cycle.
title: Restart after the outage
steps: Restart the drying cycle, or press Power to clear the display.

meaning: The oven calibration mode is active.
title: Exit calibration mode
steps: Follow the owner's manual calibration procedure to exit the mode.

meaning: The electronic oven control cannot identify the type of fault that occurred.
title: Power-cycle the range
steps: Switch the breaker off for one minute, restore power, and monitor for one minute; request service if the code returns.

meaning: A fault involving the oven temperature sensor, the control, or their wiring was detected.
title: Power-cycle then service
steps: Switch the breaker off for one minute and restore power; if the sensor code returns, service the sensor, control, or wiring.

meaning: A fault involving the user interface or keypad, the control, or their wiring was detected.
title: Power-cycle then service
steps: Switch the breaker off for one minute and restore power; if the keypad code returns, service the interface, control, or wiring.

meaning: A fault involving the oven temperature sensor, the control, or their wiring was detected.
title: Power-cycle then service
steps: Switch the breaker off for one minute and restore power; if the sensor code returns, service the sensor, control, or wiring.

meaning: A fault involving the oven temperature sensor or warming drawer sensor was detected.
title: Power-cycle then service
steps: Switch the breaker off for one minute and restore power; if the code returns, service the oven or warming-drawer sensor wiring.

meaning: The cooling fan speed is too low, from an airflow restriction, the fan, or its wiring.
title: Clear the cooling airflow
steps: Check for airflow restrictions around the cooling fan, then power-cycle at the breaker; service the fan or wiring if the code returns.

meaning: An electrical wiring or power-supply problem was detected.
title: Have the wiring verified
steps: Have a qualified electrician verify the wiring and supply voltage; avoid pressing keys during the ten-second power-up delay after outages.

meaning: The control lock feature is enabled.
title: Disable the control lock
steps: Follow the owner's manual procedure to turn off the control lock feature.

meaning: A power failure interrupted operation.
title: Clear the power-failure code
steps: Press Cancel and reset the time-of-day clock if needed.

meaning: Sabbath mode is active.
title: Exit Sabbath mode
steps: Follow the owner's manual procedure for entering and exiting Sabbath mode.

meaning: No detergent cartridge is detected in the dispenser.
title: Reseat the detergent cartridge
steps: Insert the dispenser cartridge correctly and close the drawer fully; ignore the message when using single-dose packs.

meaning: The washer is not draining properly.
title: Review the installation
steps: Slow draining is often an installation issue; verify the drain setup and schedule service if it persists.

meaning: The door is not locking properly.
title: Clear the door and reset
steps: Remove anything blocking the door so it closes fully, then press Pause/Cancel twice and Power once to clear.

meaning: The door is not locking properly.
title: Replace the door latch
steps: If nothing blocks the door and the lock error returns after clearing, disconnect power and replace the door latch assembly.

meaning: A motor speed-sensing error was detected.
title: Check bolts and load
steps: Confirm all shipping bolts were removed and the drum is not overloaded, then press Pause/Cancel twice and Power once.

meaning: The washer senses a low flow of water during fill.
title: Open the water supply
steps: Turn the household supply on, open both faucets fully, straighten kinked inlet hoses, and remove any anti-flood devices.

meaning: A problem was detected with the dispenser system.
title: Clean the dispenser
steps: Check the detergent drawer or cartridge for clogged detergent and clean it out.

meaning: Draining is taking longer than expected (over about eight minutes).
title: Clear the drain path
steps: Straighten or unclog the drain hose, fit the U-shaped form, keep the standpipe between 39 and 96 inches, and use HE detergent.

meaning: Draining is taking longer than expected (over about eight minutes).
title: Replace the drain pump
steps: If the drain path is clear and draining still exceeds eight minutes, disconnect power and water, open the access panel, and replace the drain pump.

meaning: The hot and cold inlet hoses are connected in reverse.
title: Swap the hoses
steps: Turn off the water supply, reverse the hot and cold inlet hoses, and run a cycle to confirm.

meaning: The cycle was paused or cancelled.
title: Clear the interrupted cycle
steps: Press Pause/Cancel twice and Power once; if the code stays, disconnect power for five minutes.

meaning: The lid is not locking.
title: Clear the lid lock
steps: Remove items from under the lid and clean detergent buildup around the lid-lock mechanism.

meaning: The lid cannot unlock.
title: Clear the washer top
steps: Remove objects such as a laundry basket from the top of the washer so the lid can unlock.

meaning: The lid was left open.
title: Close the lid
steps: Close the lid to clear the display; if the tub drained after ten minutes, restart without adding more detergent.

meaning: The control lock is active, disabling the panel.
title: Release the control lock
steps: Press (or press and hold) the Control Lock button; on older models the owner's manual identifies which button toggles the lock.

meaning: The load is out of balance.
title: Rebalance the load
steps: Redistribute items loosely and evenly around the washplate, close the lid, and press Start/Pause; use the Bulky cycle for oversized items.

meaning: The load is too large.
title: Lighten the load
steps: Remove several items, add HE detergent, close the lid, and press Start/Pause.

meaning: The wash cycle was interrupted by a power failure.
title: Restart after the outage
steps: Touch and hold Start to resume the cycle, or press Power to clear the display.

meaning: Items were detected in the drum during the Clean Washer cycle.
title: Empty the drum
steps: Remove all items from the drum and restart the Clean Washer cycle.

meaning: Too many suds were detected in the wash.
title: Cut the suds
steps: Switch to HE detergent, avoid no-splash chlorine bleach, and confirm the drain hose is not kinked or clogged.
